reaction.trapRisk: The working expectation for this episode remains pivot-and-fail: a sudden bounce that traps buyers expecting a continued rise. Monday's bounce (SPX +0.41%, SMH +1.61%, settled VIX -7.75%) is exactly the first-bounce shape — it is NOT an entry, even though SMH entering Zone 1 moved us to Probe. Probe here means verification work, not buying the bounce. Entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict (SPX 7,750-7,820 / SMH 580-600): either a rejection that returns price toward Zone 1/2 with the tally improved beyond 2/4, or a held close above the failure zone that disarms the trap. Chasing the first green move is the exact trade this episode is set up to punish.
